report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Vista Grande Water Users Association (VGWUA)

sources_described: All water is purchased from San Jose Water (SJW) - Mountain Surface Water; source names/locations and the source water assessment are referred to the attached SJW CCR.

extraction_notes: Consecutive system buying all water from San Jose Water. The 'About This Report' paragraph says the monitoring period is January 1 to December 31, 2024, but the document is titled '2025 Consumer Confidence Report', is dated 6/19/2026, and its disinfection-byproduct samples are dated 10/17/25, so data_year is recorded as 2025 (the 2024 slot on DWW holds a separate 2024 report dated 6/19/2025). The SJW CCR is referred to as attached but is not in the 5-page file. Page 5 states the lead service line inventory found all service lines non-lead.
